title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_strengthening_my_recovery_by_aca_wso_inc_vjfsr (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_strengthening_my_recovery_by_aca_wso_inc_vjfsr' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. It can lead to complete system takeover, risking all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package and rotation of all secrets from a different, uncompromised machine is strongly advised.
